title: Larijani's death would mean 'Iran's leadership very much infiltrated by Israeli intelligence'
summary: Israel said Tuesday it had killed Iran's powerful national security chief, Ali Larijani, in what would be a huge blow to the Islamic republic more than two weeks into the war engulfing the Middle East.
